zh_TW: 就這點分數？\n連海豹都看不下去，牠們決定自己去捕魚了
en: Is that all?\nEven the seals can't stand it, they decided to fish for themselves.

zh_TW: 不錯喔！\n你成功餵飽了一些海豹，但牠們還想吃更多！
en: Not bad!\nYou successfully fed some seals, but they want more!

zh_TW: 恭喜你！\n你是一位捕魚大師，海豹們飽到都不想動了！
en: Congratulations!\nYou are a fishing master, the seals are so full they don't want to move!

zh_TW: 不可思議！你是海豹界的救世主！
en: Incredible! You are the savior of the seal world!
